Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using tandem IP. While the text discusses sumoylation extensively and uses SUMOsp software for bioinformatics analysis of external datasets, the actual MS runs described in the methods for this study did not use SUMO-specific enrichment (e.g., K-QQTGG antibodies) or search for SUMO remnants; they used standard tryptic digestion and searched for N-acetylation and oxidation. PRIDE metadata incorrectly lists 'Top-down proteomics' in experimentTypes, but the methods explicitly describe tryptic digestion and peptide-level analysis (Bottom-up).
